# Medveczky Performance

> Online sprint kayak coaching by Erika Medveczky, a Hungarian Olympic sprint kayaker (4th place, Tokyo 2020), 8x World Champion, 6x European Champion and 21x Hungarian Champion. Based in Gainesville, Georgia, USA; coaching athletes in the U.S. and worldwide. All feedback comes from Erika personally; coaching is not automated or AI-generated.

## Coaching options

- Technique Review: $225, one-time. Personal video technique analysis with clear technical priorities, corrections and drill recommendations. No monthly commitment.
- Performance Coaching: $425 per month. Personalized training plan with regular adjustments, weekly feedback, monthly technique review, direct messaging and a monthly coaching call. Limited to 8 athletes, 3-month minimum.
- High Performance Coaching: $695 per month. Full training and season planning, priority feedback and technique analysis, biweekly calls, race preparation, tapering and competition support. Limited to 4 athletes, 3-month minimum.

## How to start

- Every athlete starts with an application: https://www.medveczkyperformance.com/apply
- Applicants must be at least 13. Applicants aged 13 to 17 must provide a parent or guardian's name and email.
- Contact: erika@medveczkyperformance.com

- [About Erika](https://www.medveczkyperformance.com/about): background, career and coaching approach
